pages.title: Welcome, Engineer
text: This handbook covers every Jugcraft machine: what it does, what it needs and how to build it.
Pick a chapter on the left. Page through a chapter with the arrows.
Power is measured in JE (Jugcraft Energy) per tick, fluids in mB (1,000 mB is a bucket).

pages.title: Your First Power
text: Mine tin and zinc, then make bronze (3 copper + 1 tin) by hand and smelt it.
Build a Machine Casing (bronze and zinc), a Coal Generator and some Copper Cable, then an Electric Furnace. Run cable from the generator to the furnace, or place them side by side.
Every machine holds its own charge, so it keeps working for a while after the power stops.

pages.title: Milestones
text: Your advancements (key L) track these steps.
Jugcraft: Dig up tin, the first metal of the workshop.
Bronze Age: Alloy tin and copper into bronze.
Geo-Resonance: Build a prospector and listen for ore underground.
Spark of Industry: Build a coal generator.
Twice the Ore: Build a crusher and double your ingots.

pages.title: Milestones (2)
text: Down to Dust: Build a pulverizer for byproducts.
Stored Lightning: Build a battery box.
Hands Off: Build an auto-crafter.
Elbow Grease: Make a hand crank: power by hand.
Full Steam Ahead: Build a steam engine to turn your shafts.

pages.title: Milestones (3)
text: Iron Horse: Build the large steam engine.
Belt Drive: Carry rotation across a gap with belt pulleys.
Assembly Line: Build a conveyor.
Sorting It Out: Split a conveyor line three ways.
Forged in Coke: Make steel.

pages.title: Milestones (4)
text: Blast Furnace: Build the steel foundry.
Capacitance: Build a capacitor bank.
Plugged In: Build a charging station.
Power Drill: Make a mining drill.
Timber!: Make a chainsaw.

pages.title: Milestones (5)
text: Tinkerer: Make an upgrade module for a powered tool.
Rocketeer: Make a rocket pack and take to the air.

pages.title: Ores
text: Jugcraft ores appear in the stone and deepslate of every Overworld biome:
Tin: Y -32 to 96, needs a stone pickaxe.
Zinc: Y -16 to 80, needs a stone pickaxe.
Lead: Y -48 to 64, needs a stone pickaxe.
Silver: Y -64 to 32, needs a iron pickaxe.
Nickel: Y -64 to 16, needs a iron pickaxe.
Tungsten: Y -64 to 0, needs a iron pickaxe.
Uranium: Y -64 to -16, needs a iron pickaxe.
Rock Salt: Y 0 to 64.
Phosphorite: Y -16 to 48.
Lepidolite: Y -48 to 32.
Monazite: Y -64 to 16.

pages.title: Geo-Resonance Prospector
text: Right-click to survey the 3x3 chunks around you, from the bottom of the world to a little above you. It shows which ores resonate, how strongly (1 to 5 bars) and roughly how deep, never exactly where.

pages.title: Ore Drill
text: Two blocks tall. Mines the ore blocks in a 9x9 column below it, one layer at a time down to the bottom of the world, one ore every 2 seconds. Each hole is refilled with stone or deepslate. The ores come out whole, ready for ore processing.
Uses 32 JE/t while working. Holds 20,000 JE.

pages.title: Ore Processing
text: Smelting an ore gives one ingot.
Crushing or pulverizing it first gives 2.
Washing it, then pulverizing the washed ore, gives 3.
Pulverizing ore sometimes gives a second metal's dust: copper gives gold, iron gives nickel, gold gives silver, tin gives tungsten, zinc gives lead, lead gives silver.

pages.title: Parts
text: Plates (Metal Press): copper, iron, tin, bronze, brass, invar, aluminum, nickel, lead, tungsten, steel.
Gears (four plates): iron, bronze, brass, invar, steel.
Wires (Wire Drawer): copper, silver, aluminum.
Every part works with other mods' parts through c: tags.

pages.title: Coal Generator
text: Burns coal, charcoal, coal blocks or coke to make power. Coke lasts twice as long as coal, and charcoal three quarters as long. It stops burning when full, so fuel is never wasted.
Makes up to 32 JE/t. Holds 16,000 JE.

pages.title: Solar Panel
text: Makes power from daylight under open sky: 8 JE/t in sun, half in rain, nothing at night.
Makes up to 8 JE/t. Holds 4,000 JE.

pages.title: Steam Generator
text: Boils water with coal or bitumen: twice the power of the coal generator per fuel. A water source block directly below refills it for free.
Makes up to 64 JE/t. Holds 40,000 JE.

pages.title: Geothermal Generator
text: Two blocks wide. Burns lava from its tank (buckets, pumps or pipes): one bucket lasts 1,000 ticks.
Makes up to 64 JE/t. Holds 30,000 JE.

pages.title: Wind Turbine
text: Nine blocks tall with a seven-block rotor. The higher it stands and the worse the weather, the more it makes, up to 72 JE/t (twice that in a thunderstorm). The rotor needs a clear 7x7 square in front of the top.
Makes up to 72 JE/t. Holds 48,000 JE.

pages.title: Battery Box
text: Stores power. It charges from every side and gives power out of its front only.
Holds 400,000 JE; 256 JE/t in and out.

pages.title: Copper Cable
text: Carries power between generators, batteries and machines. It connects by itself to anything that stores or uses power on the touching face.

pages.title: Silver Cable
text: A faster cable: 1,024 JE/t, four times copper. Cable tiers join into one network, which carries as much as its slowest cable.

pages.title: Aluminum Cable
text: Steel-armored power line: 4,096 JE/t, for big batteries and the arc furnace.

pages.title: Steam Engine
text: Burns coal, charcoal, coke or bitumen and boils water to turn its flywheel: 64 KE/t out of its back. Right-click with fuel or a water bucket, or feed it with hoppers, pipes and pumps; a water source below refills it. It burns only while something takes the power.

pages.title: Large Steam Engine
text: Two by two by two. Four times the small steam engine: 256 KE/t out of a shaft at the back of its upper right block, using 40 mB of water per tick and fuel four times as fast. It has a screen like the steam generator's, and a water source under it refills it.
Needs no power.

pages.title: Hand Crank
text: Place it against a shaft, gearbox or machine and right-click: each crank turns it for 5 seconds (up to 20) at 16 KE/t. Cranking makes you a little hungry.

pages.title: Iron Shaft
text: Carries rotation (KE, kinetic energy) along its length, placed like a log. Machines at the end of a shaft line run straight off it: 1 KE counts as 1 JE, with no cables.

pages.title: Brass Gearbox
text: Passes rotation out of all six sides, to branch a shaft line or turn a corner. Power is shared evenly between everything on the line.

pages.title: Belt Pulley
text: A shaft with a grooved wheel. Use a Leather Belt on two pulleys with the same axis (level with each other along it, up to 16 blocks apart) and the second turns with the first: power jumps gaps and walls.

pages.title: Leather Belt
text: Links two belt pulleys: use it on one, then on the other. Breaking a pulley drops the belt.

pages.title: Dynamo
text: Turns rotation reaching any face into JE at 75% and pushes it into cables on every side: the bridge from a shaft line to the electric network.

pages.title: Electric Motor
text: Turns JE from cables back into rotation at 75%, up to 96 KE/t out of its shaft, which points the way you looked when placing it. Motor and dynamo together always lose power.

pages.title: Electric Furnace
text: Smelts anything a vanilla furnace can, twice as fast.
Uses 10 JE/t while working. Holds 10,000 JE.

pages.title: Crusher
text: Crushes one ore into two raw ores, minerals into extra minerals, cobblestone into gravel and gravel into sand.
Uses 16 JE/t while working. Holds 10,000 JE.

pages.title: Alloy Smelter
text: A 2x2 furnace that melts two ingredients together into alloys. Power goes in only through its copper socket, on the outer side of its lower right block.
Uses 20 JE/t while working. Holds 10,000 JE.

pages.title: Metal Press
text: Presses one ingot into one plate. Four plates craft a gear.
Uses 16 JE/t while working. Holds 10,000 JE.

pages.title: Wire Drawer
text: Draws one ingot into three wires.
Uses 12 JE/t while working. Holds 10,000 JE.

pages.title: Circuit Assembler
text: Assembles circuits from up to three ingredients, in any slots.
Uses 32 JE/t while working. Holds 20,000 JE.

pages.title: Arc Furnace Controller
text: The heart of the Arc Furnace: build a solid 3x3x3 cube of Arc Furnace Casing with this block in the middle of one face, facing out. It melts what an ordinary furnace cannot.
Uses 64 JE/t while working. Holds 50,000 JE.

pages.title: Auto-Crafter
text: Crafts the crafting recipe laid out in its 3x3 grid. Set the pattern by hand; each grid slot keeps its last item as the pattern, so it crafts while every filled slot holds two or more. Pipes and hoppers top up slots that already hold that item. Empty buckets and bottles go to the slot above the output.
Uses 8 JE/t while working. Holds 10,000 JE.

pages.title: Pulverizer
text: Grinds ore into two dusts, with a chance of a second metal. Also grinds washed ore, raw metal and ingots.
Uses 20 JE/t while working. Holds 10,000 JE.

pages.title: Ore Washer
text: Washes one ore into three washed ores, using 500 mB of water each time. Grind them in the pulverizer.
Uses 16 JE/t while working. Holds 10,000 JE.

pages.title: Sieve
text: Sifts gravel into flint and soul sand into soul soil, with a small chance of nuggets or quartz.
Uses 8 JE/t while working. Holds 10,000 JE.

pages.title: Sawmill
text: Cuts logs into six planks (four by hand) with sawdust, and planks into three sticks.
Uses 12 JE/t while working. Holds 10,000 JE.

pages.title: Coke Oven
text: Two blocks tall, needs no power. Bakes coal into coal coke, a hotter fuel and the carbon for steel.
Needs no power.

pages.title: Steel Foundry
text: Three blocks tall, needs no power. Refines one iron ingot with one coke into one steel ingot.
Needs no power.

pages.title: Charging Station
text: Two blocks tall. Hang a drill, chainsaw or rocket pack on its cradle and it fills it from cables, 512 JE a tick; take it back with an empty hand. Its lamp lights while it charges.

pages.title: Mining Drill
text: Runs on JE instead of wearing out: 60 JE a block, 100,000 JE when full. Mines everything a pickaxe or shovel does, faster than netherite. Sneak and use it to switch mode: one block, a 3x3 square, or a whole ore vein. Empty, it mines like a bare hand.

pages.title: Chainsaw
text: A JE-powered axe that also cuts leaves: 40 JE a block. Cutting a log fells the whole tree above it; sneak to cut one log.

pages.title: Rocket Pack
text: Wear it and hold jump in the air to fly, 50 JE a tick (200,000 JE when full). Landing is safe while it fires. On a dedicated server, set allow-flight=true or long hovers get you kicked.

pages.title: Overclock Module
text: Mines 50% faster for twice the JE a block (up to 2). Fit it by using it on a charging station holding the tool; it is used up and stays in the tool.

pages.title: Range Module
text: The drill's area mode mines 5×5 (drill only). Fit it by using it on a charging station holding the tool; it is used up and stays in the tool.

pages.title: Capacity Module
text: Holds its base charge again (up to 2). Fit it by using it on a charging station holding the tool; it is used up and stays in the tool.

pages.title: Silk Touch Module
text: Blocks drop themselves (drill or chainsaw; not with fortune). Fit it by using it on a charging station holding the tool; it is used up and stays in the tool.

pages.title: Fortune Module
text: More ore drops, up to Fortune III (drill only; not with silk touch). Fit it by using it on a charging station holding the tool; it is used up and stays in the tool.

pages.title: Bronze Fluid Pipe
text: Carries fluid that a pump pushes into it to every tank and fluid machine it touches.

pages.title: Steel Fluid Pipe
text: Like the bronze pipe, but carries 1,000 mB a tick for refinery flows. A pipe line carries as much as its slowest pipe, so one bronze pipe holds a steel line back to 250 mB.

pages.title: Tinplate Tank
text: Holds 16 buckets of one fluid. Fill or empty it with buckets; right-click with an empty hand to read it.

pages.title: Electric Pump
text: Pulls water or lava from the block below it and pushes it out of its top and sides.

pages.title: Heavy Pump
text: A steel-tier pump: 1,000 mB a tick from below (water, lava or a tank) out of its top and sides, at 40 JE a tick, with a 16-bucket buffer.

pages.title: Crude Oil
text: Crude oil lies in hidden reservoirs under some Overworld chunks. The prospector reports Oil (pumpable) and Shale oil (needs fracking) under the 3x3 chunks around you.
It is a thick, slow fluid that never makes new sources, so every reservoir runs dry in the end.
Pipes, pumps and tanks carry it like water; refineries turn it into fuels.

pages.title: Pumpjack
text: One block wide, three tall and three long; place it with the wellhead where you want the well. If the chunk under the wellhead holds pumpable oil (the prospector's Oil reading), it pumps 2 mB of crude oil a tick into its 16-bucket tank and pushes it into pipes and tanks touching it. A reservoir runs dry for good after 50 to 250 buckets; shale oil needs a fracking rig instead.
Uses 32 JE/t while working. Holds 20,000 JE.

pages.title: Oil Sand Extractor
text: Two by two by two. Washes crude oil out of oil sand with hot water: a block of oil sand (mined with silk touch) and 250 mB of water give 500 mB of crude oil and a block of sand; a piece of bitumen and 100 mB of water give 150 mB. Pipe water in; it pushes the oil out into pipes and tanks touching it.
Uses 32 JE/t while working. Holds 20,000 JE.

pages.title: Distillation Tower
text: Two by two and seven blocks tall. Heats crude oil and splits each bucket into 100 mB of refinery gas, 250 mB of naphtha, 400 mB of diesel and 250 mB of heavy fuel oil, a bucket every 5 seconds. Each fraction comes out at its own height: heavy fuel oil at the base, diesel two blocks up, naphtha four up, and refinery gas at the top. Give each its own pipe or tank.
Uses 128 JE/t while working. Holds 40,000 JE.

pages.title: Catalytic Cracker
text: Two by two and four blocks tall. Cracks heavy fuel oil into lighter fuels with steam and a catalyst: 1,000 mB of heavy fuel oil, 250 mB of water and a cracking catalyst give 500 mB of diesel (out at the base), 300 mB of naphtha (two blocks up) and 200 mB of refinery gas (at the top), every 8 seconds.
Uses 160 JE/t while working. Holds 40,000 JE.

pages.title: Vacuum Distillation Unit
text: Two by two and three blocks tall. Boils heavy fuel oil under vacuum: each bucket gives 400 mB of lubricant and two asphalt binder, every 6 seconds. Lubricant keeps the gas turbine running; asphalt binder makes roads.
Uses 96 JE/t while working. Holds 30,000 JE.

pages.title: Catalytic Reformer
text: Three wide, two tall and two deep. Reforms naphtha into high-octane gasoline: each bucket of naphtha gives 900 mB of gasoline (out of the bottom row) and 100 mB of refinery gas (out of the top row), every 6 seconds.
Uses 120 JE/t while working. Holds 30,000 JE.

pages.title: Chemical Mixer
text: Two by two by two. Stirs powders into water: two sand (first slot) and a dried kelp (second slot) with a bucket of water make a bucket of fracking fluid, every 4 seconds.
Uses 64 JE/t while working. Holds 20,000 JE.

pages.title: Fracking Rig
text: Three by three and five blocks tall. Place it with its front left block over shale oil (the prospector's Shale oil reading). Each powered tick it pumps 4 mB of fracking fluid down the well and brings up 6 mB of crude oil (out at the base), 2 mB of refinery gas (out at the top) and 3 mB of flowback water (out one block up), until the shale is spent.
Uses 256 JE/t while working. Holds 80,000 JE.

pages.title: Flowback Treatment Unit
text: Three wide, one tall and two deep. Settles and filters the flowback water from a fracking rig: each bucket gives 750 mB of clean water and a salt, every 4 seconds. Pipe the water back to the chemical mixer; a quarter is lost each time round.
Uses 48 JE/t while working. Holds 20,000 JE.

pages.title: Diesel Generator
text: Three wide, two tall and two deep. Burns diesel or heavy fuel oil piped into its 8-bucket tank: 256 JE/t, a bucket of diesel every 1,000 ticks (256,000 JE) or heavy fuel oil twice as fast (128,000 JE a bucket). It refuses crude oil and other fluids.
Makes up to 256 JE/t. Holds 60,000 JE.

pages.title: Gas Turbine
text: Four wide, two tall and two deep. Burns gasoline or refinery gas from its 16-bucket tank: 512 JE/t, 384,000 JE a bucket of gasoline or 192,000 JE a bucket of gas. Its second tank takes lubricant from the vacuum distillation unit: 1 mB every second of running, and it stops when it runs dry.
Makes up to 512 JE/t. Holds 120,000 JE.

pages.title: Cracking Catalyst
text: Bauxite (alumina) and sand (silica) with a nickel ingot make four. The catalytic cracker uses one for each bucket of heavy fuel oil it cracks.

pages.title: Machine Sides
text: Every processing machine's screen has six face buttons: front, back, left, right, top and bottom.
Click one to cycle: In (blue), Out (orange), Both (green) or Off (gray).
Eject makes the machine push its results out of its Out faces by itself.
The R button sets how it reacts to redstone: always run, run with a signal, or run without one.

pages.title: Brass Item Pipe
text: Joins inventories into a network. Items go to matching sorters first, then take turns between the other inventories.

pages.title: Pneumatic Extractor
text: Pulls 16 items every 8 ticks from what it faces and pushes them out of its other sides. A redstone signal pauses it.

pages.title: High-Pressure Extractor
text: A steel extractor: 32 items every 4 ticks, four times the brass one.

pages.title: Item Sorter
text: Takes only the items in its 9-slot filter, and puts them into the inventory it faces.

pages.title: Conveyor
text: Carries items the way you faced when placing it, 2.5 blocks a second, while rotation drives it. A shaft, gearbox or motor on any side drives every conveyor joined to it, for 1 KE per conveyor per tick. Pipes, hoppers and machines load it, and so do items dropped on it; at the end items go into the conveyor or inventory ahead, or onto the ground. It carries you too; sneak to stand still.

pages.title: Conveyor Splitter
text: A conveyor that sends items left, straight on and right in turn, skipping any way that is blocked.

pages.title: Conveyor Slope
text: Carries items one block up, onto the top of the block in front, or down from a conveyor one block higher behind it. Use it with an empty hand to switch between up and down. It joins and runs with the conveyors around it.

pages.title: Brass Wrench
text: Right-click turns a machine. Sneak and right-click to pick a Jugcraft block up, with everything inside.

pages.title: Item Crate
text: Holds 32 stacks of one item. Right-click with an item to put it in, with an empty hand to take a stack out (sneak to just look). Works with pipes, hoppers and comparators.

pages.title: Capacitor Bank
text: A 2x2 bank of Leyden jars: 4,000,000 JE. It charges from any side and gives power out of the sockets on its front, 4,096 JE/t.
Holds 4,000,000 JE; 4096 JE/t in and out.

pages.title: Steel Tank
text: A 2x2 riveted tank: 128 buckets of one fluid. Buckets, pumps and pipes fill and empty it; right-click with an empty hand to read it.
Needs no power.

pages.title: Water Wheel
text: Two blocks tall. The wheel on its right side turns in flowing water: 8 JE/t for each of its two blocks with flowing water beside it, 12 if the water is falling. Still water does not turn it.
Makes up to 24 JE/t. Holds 8,000 JE.

pages.title: Cobblestone Generator
text: Makes one cobblestone a second while water and lava touch it, on any sides. Neither is used up. Speed upgrades make it faster.
Uses 4 JE/t while working. Holds 4,000 JE.

pages.title: Tree Farm
text: Grows a sapling into six logs in 20 seconds and gives the sapling back, sometimes with an apple, cocoa beans or other extras. Feed the sapling back in with eject and a pipe for endless wood.
Uses 16 JE/t while working. Holds 10,000 JE.

pages.title: Speed Upgrade
text: In a machine's upgrade slot: each card makes it faster but uses more energy per item. Four cards: 3x as fast for twice the energy.

pages.title: Efficiency Upgrade
text: In a machine's upgrade slot: each card cuts energy use by a fifth. Four cards: 41% of the energy.

pages.title: Comparators
text: A comparator next to a generator or battery shows how full it is.
Next to a processing machine, it shows how full its slots are, like a chest.
